title: fix: resolve CUDA graph capture/replay warmup regression with shape guards
author: Markus Lee
description:
Context: A regression was observed in production after the CUDA graph capture/replay changes merged in earlier PRs that adjusted when we capture graphs during warmup. Symptoms: increased tail latency on short sequences and intermittent wrong KV-cache bindings when continuous batching transitions caused shape-guard instability. Root cause: graph capture was occurring before the runtime stabilized per-shape guards for batched inputs; captured graphs could be replayed with an incompatible KV cache layout when the dynamic batcher merged requests with different pad/attention shapes. Fix: 1) Delay graph capture until shape guards have been observed for N consecutive iterations (configurable warmup_count=3). 2) Reify a stable shape-key (including KV layout metadata) into the capture key used by the graph cache. 3) Add invariant checks during replay to assert KV cache compatibility and fall back to un-captured path if mismatched, emitting a metric (cuda_graph.replay_mismatch). 4) Add a targeted scheduler tweak so the continuous batcher prefers sessions with stable shape-key history during warmup windows. Tests & validation: - New unit+integration tests (tests/perf/cuda_graph_warmup_test.py) that reproduce the previous regression behavior and assert correct replay/fallback behavior. - Microbenchmark: end-to-end perf bench on a 8-GPU A100 pool shows 2.7% throughput uplift and a >30% reduction in 99th percentile latency for short sequences when warmup_count=3. - Stress test with dynamic batching for mixed sequence lengths (internal perf harness) for 1M requests shows zero KV misbinds after the fix. Rollout: Feature-gated behind runtime.config.cuda_graph_warmup.enabled (default true) and warmup_count=3. Backported as a hotfix to the 2024.10 release branch for one affected customer (SUP-412). See docs/notes/cuda-graph-warmup.md for operational notes and metrics to watch. Checklist:
- [x] Reproduce regression locally
- [x] Add unit & integration tests
- [x] Add metrics and logging for mismatches
- [x] Run perf suite on CI matrices
- [x] Add feature flag and config defaults
patch_snippets: runtime/cuda/graph_capture.cpp: add warmup_count check before capturing and include kv_layout in capture key
runtime/cuda/graph_replay.cpp: verify capture_key.kv_layout == current.kv_layout and emit metric on mismatch; fallback path added
runtime/scheduler/batcher.cpp: prefer sessions with stable shape history during warmup windows (configurable)
tests/perf/cuda_graph_warmup_test.py: reproducer for mismatched replay path and assertions for metric emission
docs/notes/cuda-graph-warmup.md: operational notes and tuning guidance
review_comments: Alice Johnson: Nice find — the invariant check on replay looks necessary. Please ensure metric cardinality is bounded and add unit tests for mismatch path.
Markus Lee: Added bounded metric tags (shape_bucket only) and unit test for mismatch path; updated tests to assert metric emission.
Diego Martinez: Morphing the capture key worries me for compatibility with saved graphs on Dedicated nodes. Did you add versioning to the capture key?

Markus Lee: Yes — capture_key now includes a numeric schema_version and we increment it when we change key shape; backward compatibility path falls back to non-captured execution if an unknown schema is seen.
Priya Kapoor: Can we add a short note in runtime/upgrade.md about potential warmup behavior and that customers may want to tune warmup_count?
Markus Lee: Added docs/notes/cuda-graph-warmup.md and a snippet in runtime/upgrade.md pointing to it.
CI Bot: linux/build passed, linux/unit tests passed, perf/bench quick-run passed, flake8 lint passed. Windows build flaky on first run, rerun succeeded.
perf_results: 8x A100: +2.7% throughput on average for mixed short sequences
Stress test 1M requests: 0 KV misbinds after fix vs ~120 in regression scenario
release_notes: Fixes regression that caused incorrect CUDA graph replay under dynamic batching when shape guards were unstable; adds warmup gating and replay invariants. Backported hotfix to 2024.10 for affected customers.
